about: Every project, where it lives under the dev root on every PC, and how it connects. Layout.ps1 plan uses this to move or clone projects into place; Layout.ps1 index uses it for INDEX.md. Projects in a restricted domain (onlyOn) are never listed here. Add a row when you start a project.

fields.path: where it lives under the dev root (the same on every PC)
fields.folder: the folder name a PC may still have at the top of the dev root from an older flat layout
fields.aliases: older names for the same folder
fields.repo: clone URL, or null if it only exists on one PC
fields.drive: its files in the synced drive, relative to driveRoot
fields.node: id of the matching note in your notes app (optional)
